rule: Rust linting enforced via cargo clippy with workspace clippy.toml
notes: Zero warnings allowed on clippy sweep

rule: New WebAssembly proposals must be feature-gated and disabled by default until standardized
notes: Proposals must advance to W3C Phase 4 before default enabling

rule: Compiler and runtime changes must be covered by fuzzing harnesses
mechanical_form: cargo fuzz (libFuzzer/AFL) in CI and OSS-Fuzz
notes: Differential fuzzing against V8, SpiderMonkey, and reference interpreter

rule: Significant architectural or design changes require a Bytecode Alliance RFC
notes: Consensus required among project maintainers

rule: Code review: all pull requests require review and approval from a project maintainer
notes: Maintainer checklist covers tests, docs, security

rule: Release notes: user-facing additions, changes, and deprecations recorded in RELEASES.md
notes: SemVer major bumps every month on monthly release cadence

rule: Testing: automated tests run via cargo test across all crates
notes: Wasm spec testsuite in tests/spec_testsuite.rs

rule: Security vulnerabilities must be reported through security advisory process in docs/security.md
notes: Coordinated security response team with SLA

rule: Apache 2.0 License with LLVM Exception applies to all code contributions
notes: Bytecode Alliance standard licensing

rule: CI matrix validation: PRs must pass multi-platform build and test matrix in GitHub Actions
notes: Tests x86_64, aarch64, s390x, riscv64

rule: Python formatting enforced with Black
notes: Excludes test-data/ fixtures

rule: Python linting enforced with Ruff
notes: Runs with --exit-non-zero-on-fix

rule: Trailing whitespace and end-of-file newlines enforced by pre-commit hooks
notes: Standard pre-commit cleanliness

rule: Spell checking enforced across codebase via codespell
notes: Excludes test-data/ and typeshed/

rule: GitHub Actions workflows validated with actionlint and shellcheck
notes: Shellcheck checks embedded shell scripts in workflow runs

rule: GitHub Actions security audited via zizmor
notes: Audits CI actions for supply chain and secret exfiltration vulnerabilities

rule: Pull request links in CHANGELOG.md validated via pygrep hook
notes: Verifies markdown link text matches destination PR number

rule: Self-type-checking: mypy must pass type check on itself using mypy.ini
notes: Strict typing enforced across mypy codebase

rule: Automated regression tests required for all bug fixes and features via pytest
notes: Data-driven test suite in test-data/unit/

rule: Typeshed submodule changes: typeshed changes must be submitted upstream to python/typeshed
notes: mypy vendors typeshed via submodule or sync script

rule: Python Software Foundation Code of Conduct applies to all participants
notes: Standard PSF Code of Conduct

rule: MIT License applies to mypy contributions
notes: Permissive MIT license terms
